findings.evidence: Line 22 exposes the whole section; lines 40–42, 54–56, 89–97, 118–122, and 128–132 provide the membership/evaluation API. The reported export failures concern proofs written `:= rfl`; Lean supports `:= (rfl)` specifically to export such lemmas without making their dependencies exposed.
findings.fix: Use `public section` without `@[expose]` and write the six exported definitional proofs as `:= (rfl)` (and similarly parenthesize `mem_iff` if required), exposing only an individual definition if an actual consumer must unfold it.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes `ClassFunction`, both quotient constructors, the linear equivalence, and both character constructors, although their public characteristic lemmas make downstream unfolding unnecessary.

summary: The characteristic API is now annotated, but the file still exposes every implementation body solely to export definitional proofs.
